![security-medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/security-medium-priority.svg) ![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

While allowing write access to `/opt/actions-runner` is necessary for the JIT configuration to write `.runner` and credentials files to the root directory, we can apply defense-in-depth hardening by keeping the runner's executable binaries and external toolchains read-only.

Since systemd's `ReadOnlyPaths=` supports nested paths and the most specific prefix wins, we can explicitly mark `/opt/actions-runner/bin` and `/opt/actions-runner/externals` as read-only. This prevents a compromised runner process from modifying its own executable binaries or core toolchain during execution.

```
ReadWritePaths=/opt/actions-runner /home/gha-runner /run/cie-jit
ReadOnlyPaths=/opt/actions-runner/bin /opt/actions-runner/externals
```

+  requireMatch('jit-runner-root-writable-in-disposable-overlay', runnerBootstrapService, /ProtectSystem=strict[\s\S]+ReadWritePaths=\/opt\/actions-runner \/home\/gha-runner \/run\/cie-jit/)
+  requireMatch('jit-runner-home-readable-with-exact-write-exception', runnerBootstrapService, /ProtectHome=read-only[\s\S]+ReadWritePaths=[^\r\n]+\/home\/gha-runner/)
+  requireNoMatch('jit-runner-home-not-inaccessible', runnerBootstrapService, /ProtectHome=(?:true|yes)/i)

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Systemd configuration files accept multiple boolean representations for `true`, including `on` and `1` in addition to `true` and `yes`. Updating the regex to match `/ProtectHome=(?:true|yes|on|1)/i` ensures that all inaccessible boolean configurations are correctly rejected by the validation bundle. Additionally, ensure that fail-closed regression test cases are included in the unit tests to verify that the validation fails closed and records diagnostics when the input files are malformed or contain invalid fields.

```suggestion
  requireNoMatch('jit-runner-home-not-inaccessible', runnerBootstrapService, /ProtectHome=(?:true|yes|on|1)/i)
```

<summary>References</summary>

1. Include fail-closed regression test cases in unit tests to verify behavior when input files are missing, malformed, or contain invalid fields, asserting that diagnostics are recorded and validation fails closed.
</details>
